notes: Reviewed name equivalences between the projection source and the identity source, plus per-player overrides. Every entry is a human judgement recorded as data. Automatic fuzzy matching is deliberately NOT used: it would resolve these too, and would also silently join two different players with similar names, with no way to notice afterwards. Player names are public facts; no projection value, ranking or other proprietary figure appears in this file. Scope: every unresolved identity affecting the top 240 by recomputed season points.

alias_reasons.Marquise Brown: The identity source lists him under the nickname 'Hollywood Brown'. Same player; verified by position (WR) and by there being exactly one 'Hollywood Brown' and no 'Marquise Brown' in that source.
